youtube.description:
Claude Code shortcuts: Shift+Tab, Esc Esc, @ file, /resume and /compact. Save this cheat sheet.

5 Claude Code shortcuts that save you time. Number two undoes mistakes.

1. Shift+Tab - Press Shift+Tab to cycle permission modes, including plan.
2. Esc Esc - Press Escape twice on an empty prompt to rewind.
3. @ File - Type the at sign, then a file or folder.
4. /Resume - Run /resume to pick up an earlier conversation.
5. /Compact - Run /compact to summarize and free up context.

Needs: Pro, Max or Console

Official docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes
